title: Which country emits the most CO₂ per person?
subtitle: Pick the country that emits the most CO₂ per person from five oil and gas states, then see how a year in Congo compares with half a day there.
form: choose on the figure (tap one of five drawn flags, Gulf states + Trinidad & Tobago); dialogue: b supplies the Congo twist
notes: Reworked after review: five hard suspects (all above 20 t), ask comes second, wrong hint = 2022 World Cup; bars rise above the viewer's flag row, USA and world as dashed lines. Territorial emissions; 54 kg / (41.3 t/365) = 11.5 h, said as 'less than half a day'. Reasons spoken + small icons, not an OWID number.
